posts.text: ADHD hack: trick your brain into starting, not finishing.
My ADHD brain runs best on chaos and caffeine.
ADHD isn’t a privilege—it’s just finally being seen. This one’s personal.

The subtle signs of ADHD rarely look like a hyper kid bouncing off the walls. In adults, especially women, it looks like being the most 'on it' person at work and then crying in the bathroom because you forgot to eat lunch again. It looks like starting five projects and finishing the one due in twenty minutes. It looks like being called 'so smart' your whole life while secretly feeling one dropped ball away from everyone finding out.
Living with ADHD forgets what I’m doing halfway through doing it so I learned to design around my brain.
